inherited_literal_Vinberg_audit.criterion: Vinberg edge-endpoint criterion plus every irreducible affine component's full zero-neighborhood

lineage_and_scope.arithmetically_different_from_original_c: L and N have the same determinant but different Smith invariants: L has 1^6 2^4 4^2, whereas N has 1^4 2^8
lineage_and_scope.existing_geometric_carrier: a special Picard-rank-20 K3 with symplectic Nikulin involution and fixed rank-12 lattice L of determinant 256
lineage_and_scope.new_positive_gain: a second full-Picard rank-12 K3 carrier on the scaled-dual 2-elementary lattice N of determinant 256, with an explicit primitive K3-lattice glue and all 28 walls transported
lineage_and_scope.not_the_complete_K3_nef_chamber: the imported arrangement has eight primitive square-minus-four mirrors and is only certified as a divisor-reflection chamber

scaled_dual_K3_bridge.discriminant_quadratic_form: q_D4(-1) + <-1/2>^6; equivalently the form of U+D4(-1)+A1(-1)^6

period_consequence.statement: By K3 period surjectivity, a generic period in the signature-(2,8) orthogonal complement avoids every extra integral Noether-Lefschetz hyperplane; the resulting projective complex K3 has NS exactly N.

scaled_dual_K3_bridge.positive_halfspace_identity: For oriented primitive q in M, p=Gram(M)q/div_M(q) and Phi(x)=Gram(M)x satisfy (Phi(x),p)_N=(2/div_M(q))*(x,q)_M.

primitive_K3_embedding.classification: the unique even unimodular lattice of signature (3,19), hence the K3 lattice U^3+E8(-1)^2

stable_closure.operation: unique reflection-stable odd index-four closure before duality

theorem: The finite-volume noncompact A18 C03 H11/28 chamber has a second full-Picard complex-K3 divisor-lattice carrier. After its unique reflection-stable odd index-four closure M, the doubled dual N=M^vee(2) is the even 2-elementary lattice of type (12,8,1), embeds primitively in the K3 lattice by the displayed discriminant graph glue, and occurs as NS of a projective K3; all 28 positive halfspaces and reflections transport and their primitive mirrors generate NS.
